summary: Vortex Guard (exam) feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass covering auth for 3 roles, exam create validation (bad schedule, MC <2 options), siswa list (status/submitted/questions hidden), start flow (wrong token/upcoming/ended/success), autosave + resume, violation increment, MC auto-grading with shuffled options, duplicate attempt 409, teacher results (attempts+active+summary with violation_log), essay grading with range validation. Frontend: Vortex Guard sidebar entry works for guru/siswa; /vortex-guard page renders; guru editor modal opens, class dropdown populates (XII IPA 1), subject dropdown (Matematika), MC+essay creation flow works; results modal with rekap/live tabs opens; siswa sees exam card, token modal opens, wrong token shows 'Token ujian salah' toast; class detail Ujian tab shows Vortex Guard branded exam list. End-to-end real exam-taking (fullscreen) not driven in headless to avoid clobbering the seeded in-progress session.

issues: Two /api/auth/me 401s appear in console on first load before login - cosmetic, user flow unaffected, but noisy for devs
GET /classes fetch after modal open takes ~1-2s with no spinner on the Kelas dropdown; dropdown briefly shows only '— Pilih kelas —' placeholder. Minor UX; consider loading state.

action_items: Optional: suppress /auth/me 401 toast on login screen by only calling it after a cookie exists
Optional: show loading state in ExamEditor class dropdown while /classes fetch is in-flight
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is 5779 lines; split by domain (exams, classes, attendance, library, etc.) for maintainability
ExamEditor fetches /classes only when !klass; good. However clear separation between create-from-ClassDetail (prefilled) and global-create is already correct.
exam_status computes on-the-fly on every list — fine for current load
Grade endpoint computes att['score'] from essay percent/100 — docstring/comment would help (MC counted as 1 each, essay fractional)
seed_data_creation: Pytest creates/destroys ephemeral TEST_ exams via guru API. The UI test created and deleted TEST_UI_Exam within the same run. Seeded 'UTS Matematika' (token VG123) left intact with its in-progress siswa session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vortex Guard backend endpoints and UI (page+editor+results+take modal gate+class detail tab) all verified. If retesting UI, be aware the Kelas select in ExamEditor needs a ~2s wait after modal open for /classes XHR to resolve. Fullscreen-based exam-take flow is not driven in headless; backend attempt-submission flow is covered by pytest instead.
